utv.uk.title: Grantchester
utv.uk.description: Crime drama. Geordie is still mourning Will's departure when Mrs C charges into the pub with reports of a gentleman breaking into the vicarage - Geordie leaps into action and heads straight inside the vicarage to confront the intruder. A tussle ensues between them before Geordie is confronted by the realisation that this man is no burglar - he's the new vicar. The man introduces himself as the Reverend Alphy Kottaram - as Alphy settles into life in Grantchester, his first order of business at the church is a funeral service for local landowner Albert Baron, who apparently took his own life - when the service is abruptly interrupted by the Walkers, a family warring with the Barons, a fight breaks out in the church. As the Walkers leave, Albert's son Harvey accuses the Walkers of murdering his father - as Alphy corrals the two families into the vicarage and Geordie arrives to investigate, an initially reluctant Alphy finds himself drawn into solving clues and uncovering buried secrets. (Crime, Drama, Mystery) - 2014

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Blair Castle
utv.uk.description: James' culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands, where he's joined by top Scottish Michelin-starred chef Tom Kitchin - their journey begins with an incredible tour of the castle grounds complete with awe-inspiring views. James kicks off the cooking with his venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden, and Tom then dusts off his wellies and heads into the woods for a bit of wild mushroom foraging - this inspires James to whip up some wild mushrooms on toast with duck eggs and British truffles before he gets a masterclass in Highland gaming as young brothers David and Harry share the secrets to the famous caber toss. James then cooks up Arbroath smokie scotch eggs with curry mayonnaise - finally, James and Tom take to the water and fish in the River Gary for wild salmon... but James' too impatient to wait for a catch, cheats, and cooks up some lovely supermarket fish in his Blair Castle salmon with saffron sauce. (Documentary, Reality) - 2019

utv.uk.title: Die Another Day - Die Another Day
utv.uk.description: The 20th entry in the James Bond film series and Pierce Brosnan's final appearance as the secret agent. 007 is assigned to North Korea on a mission to assassinate a colonel when he is betrayed by a double agent at MI6 and captured - after enduring 14 months of torture, James is traded at the Korean border for Zao, a North Korean agent and associate of the colonel, in a prisoner exchange. Bond then escapes his subsequent MI6 detention and tracks Zao to Havana where he meets NSA agent Jinx and learns that she is working on the same case - James soon discovers that Zao is in league with the British diamond and technology tycoon Sir Gustav Graves... and that the two are planning to use a new satellite called Icarus to change the power balance of the world permanently.

Ince, who has provided four assists, while Colchester languishes near the bottom with a -7 goal difference. This fixture carries added spice as a rivalry clash, with the U’s needing a turnaround after losing five matches, though their defensive resilience, anchored by goalkeeper T. Lo-Tutala’s 39 saves, could frustrate a Tranmere attack led by five-goal forward D. Jones. (Sports)

bbconemidlands.uk.description: Comedy starring David Tennant and Jessica Hynes. Jingle bells give way to alarm bells when a hapless new teacher agrees to take the pupils of St Bernadette's to rural Wales to compete in a clash of the Christmas choirs. And it just so happens that his twin brother is conducting a rival group.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 Seasonal Seas The wildlife in the seasonal seas in the temperate bands between the freezing poles and the warm tropics, where changing conditions over the course of the year push animals to be resourceful and adaptable. In the winter, storms at sea whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles building to 30 metres height, while in the summer, temperatures can rise by 50 degrees Celsius in a matter of weeks.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 New Entrant Farmer Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean explores the hidden world of dung beetles in a cow pat and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S46 E11 Alexandra Gardens, Cardiff 2 Fiona Bruce presents the show from Alexandra Gardens in the heart of Cardiff, Treasures include a pipe by a renowned Maori craftsman, a jewel-encrusted stick pin given as a gift from King Edward VII and Queen Alexandra, a book listing wartime spies and a collection of medals and a cap badge belonging to one of the earliest members of the SAS.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E18 Week 9 Results Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present the second part of the Blackpool special, announcing the results of the judges' scores and viewer votes, after which the two couples with the lowest combined scores take part in a dance-off to decide who will be next to leave.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E4 Polar Waters The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Witch Farm
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E1 In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha.

United did the double over their rivals last term for the first time since the 2015/16 season, but have struggled for form so far this term. Elsewhere, the high-flying Seagulls took on a Hull side who had acquitted themselves well to life back in the top flight. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's goals.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Holiday
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Dark
eden.uk.plus1.description: Today, more than two-thirds of mammal species are nocturnal, and in this episode we will uncover the intriguing strategies they have evolved, from remarkable senses to teamwork, intelligence and adaptability, which have enabled them to overcome a time we find so challenging. Nocturnal mammals have developed an array of sharp senses. And, unlike us, many are blessed with incredible night vision. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - The New Wild
eden.uk.plus1.description: For millions of years, mammals have evolved to master every environment on Earth, but the planet is changing rapidly, all thanks to one mammal in particular - humans. As mankind reshapes the face of the world, mammals must change with it if they are to survive, let alone thrive. Today, some are finding clever and surprising ways to make the most of this new wild, while others need a helping hand from us. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Water
eden.uk.plus1.description: We witness some of the most intimate and surprising behaviours of marine mammals. Raising the bar on our understanding of how whales and dolphins make their lives at sea, as well as meeting those terrestrial mammals that dip their toes, and sometimes more, into the watery world. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Cold
eden.uk.plus1.description: Having honed their survival strategies over millennia, mammals have evolved to be masters of the cold. From icy seas to snow-capped mountains, a look at the unique mammals that call these frozen worlds home. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Hornsea to Spurn Point
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey in the pretty seaside resort of Hornsea, famous for its distinctive pottery. In Hull, he discovers how one of Hull FC's star players made history as Britain's first black rugby captain. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Grimsby to Humberston Fitties
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo has reached Lincolnshire, where his coastal railway journey from Middlesbrough ends. In Grimsby Town, he investigates a new stage in the town's history - as a maintenance base for some of the largest wind farms in the world. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 1
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo crosses the Irish Sea to start a route through the six counties of Northern Ireland, where nearly two million people live. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 2
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael is in Cushendall, one of the many isolated communities that in times past created their own entertainment, enabling the rise of Irish folklore and supernatural myths. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Bangor, where the beautiful houses facing the sea are a sign of the renaissance that the city has experienced in recent years, thanks in part to its great cultural offer. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 4
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael leaves Northern Ireland and crosses the border to the port city of Dundalk, where he visits a family business that sells oysters to restaurants around the world. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 5
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael heads to Sandycove, a popular spot for swimmers year-round, and because it was featured in James Joyce's celebrated novel 'Ulysses'. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 1
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo kicks off another rail adventure, this time on the southern shores of England, crucial to British defence. His first stop is Weymouth in Dorset. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 2
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Wareham, one of the rail gateways to Dorset's famous Jurassic Coast, to visit the country's oldest oil well. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Southampton, a large port city that is home to many maritime and scientific agencies, such as the National Oceanography Centre. (Documentary, Travel)

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v New Zealand
itv1anglia.uk.description: England v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match of the round-robin stage, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England produced an excellent display when these teams last met a year ago, claiming a 33 - 19 victory to end a run of three straight defeats at the hands of the All Blacks. With analysis from Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care, pitchside reports from Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Ireland v South Africa
itv1anglia.uk.description: Ireland v South Africa (Kick-off 4.40pm). All the action from the match at Aviva Stadium, as both teams conclude their round-robin fixtures. These nations last faced each other 12 months ago, when the world champions claimed a 24-13 victory in a chaotic encounter that saw Ireland receive five cards, even playing with 12 men at the end of the first half, and the Springboks also get reduced to 14 men in the second half. With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy.

itv1anglia.uk.title: EFL Live : Burnley v Blackburn Rovers
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E4 Burnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Die Another Day
itv1anglia.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

itv1anglia.uk.description: Fantasy musical starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande-Butera. Elphaba Thropp is an outcast among the citizens of Oz due to her green skin and magical powers. itvgranada.uk.title: EFL Championship - Burnley v Blackburn Rovers
itvgranada.uk.description: Burnley take on Blackburn Rovers in the East Lancashire Derby, and there is famous and old rivalry between the two clubs. Just 11 miles separates the two towns, and the first time they played each was in 1884, and they have met many times since. Burnley were relegated from the Premier League last season, and have struggled so far in the second tier they parted company with their manager Nicky Hayen last month, and Fabio Celestini is now in charge. (Football)

There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. talkingpictures.uk.title: The Footage Detectives

talkingpictures.uk.title: Jigsaw

talkingpictures.uk.title: Fox - Just an Iron Monkey

talkingpictures.uk.title: An Innocent Man

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail

bbcfour.uk.description: Seamus Heaney travels across Lough Erne in Fermanagh. [1978]

bbcfour.uk.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
bbcfour.uk.description: 6/10. Michael Palin reaches Australia, where his activities include a cameo role in Home and Away. He also looks for sperm whales in New Zealand's icy waters.

bbcfour.uk.title: Miss Marple: The Moving Finger
bbcfour.uk.description: 2/2. Miss Marple's instinct - that one murder will always follow another - proves to be true when more bodies are found in the sleepy town.

bbcfour.uk.description: Celia Imrie tells the story of the Ice Queen of French cinema, Catherine Deneuve.

bbcfour.uk.title: Belle de Jour
bbcfour.uk.description: A bored young housewife decides to spend her midweek afternoons working at a high-class brothel. Louis Bunuel's erotic masterpiece. Contains scenes of a sexual nature. [1967]

bbcfour.uk.title: On the Set of Belle de Jour - Release
bbcfour.uk.description: Veteran film-maker Luis Buñuel shown at work on his 1967 film Belle de Jour. Deals with adult themes.

bbcfour.uk.title: Kirsty Wark Talks to Catherine Deneuve
bbcfour.uk.description: Kirsty Wark interviews renowned French actress Catherine Deneuve about her life and career.

bbcfour.uk.title: The Life and Times of Don Luis Buñuel - Arena
bbcfour.uk.description: Illuminating portrait of one of the great masters of cinema, Luis Buñuel. Deals with adult themes.

bbcfour.uk.title: To the Manor Born
bbcfour.uk.description: 4/7. Sitcom about a lady of the manor who is forced to give up her home to a grocery tycoon. A rare bird nesting on the estate attracts interest among local naturalists.

bbcfour.uk.title: Keeping Up Appearances
bbcfour.uk.description: 8/10. Sitcom. When Bruce and Violet's constant arguing threatens Hyacinth's luxury barbecue, she resorts to desperate musical measures to keep her family scandals from public exposure.

bbcfour.uk.description: 2/2. Miss Marple's instinct - that one murder will always follow another - proves to be true when more bodies are found in the sleepy town.

bbcfour.uk.title: Scotland: Rome's Final Frontier
bbcfour.uk.description: Archaeologist Dr Fraser Hunter looks back on three centuries of contact and conflict with Scotland's Roman invaders, a story of a superpower pitted against tribesmen and warlords.

bbcfour.uk.title: Treasures of the Anglo Saxons
bbcfour.uk.description: Dr Nina Ramirez reveals the codes and messages hidden in Anglo-Saxon art by examining artefacts like the Sutton Hoo treasures, the Staffordshire hoard and the Franks Casket. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Sondheim at the BBC

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Game Night
cinemax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Comedy, Action) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemax.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (Documentary) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Lobster
cinemax.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music, Documentary) - 2019

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: The East
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxaction.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (movie) - 1971

cinemaxaction.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (movie) - 2025

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxaction.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxaction.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxaction.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scream
cinemaxaction.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (movie) - 1996

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (movie) - 2016

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Watchers
cinemaxaction.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trap
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxaction.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (movie) - 1956

cinemaxaction.us.title: Son of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (movie) - 1967

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (movie) - 1987

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxaction.us.title: It
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxaction.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemaxaction.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxaction.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Room
cinemaxaction.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxaction.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemaxaction.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (movie) - 1973

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hop
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Flashpoint
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (movie) - 1984

cinemaxclassics.us.title: For All Mankind
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (movie) - 1989

cinemaxclassics.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Holla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Odd Jobs
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Repo Men
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (movie) - 2005

cinemaxclassics.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Lord of the Flies
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (movie) - 1963

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Time Bandits
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxclassics.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (movie) - 2000

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Despicable Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Daytrippers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (movie) - 1996

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mississippi Masala
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (movie) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (movie) - 2001

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (movie) - 2004

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (movie) - 2007

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxhits.us.title: Trap
cinemaxhits.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxhits.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxhits.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxhits.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Epic
cinemaxhits.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: Mojave
cinemaxhits.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxhits.us.title: Beirut
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Aftermath
cinemaxhits.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxhits.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (movie) - 1970

cinemaxhits.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemaxhits.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (movie) - 2019

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxhits.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxhits.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Perfect Match
cinemaxhits.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (movie) - 2016

cinemaxhits.us.title: Companion
cinemaxhits.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (movie) - 2025

cinemaxhits.us.title: Bring Her Back
cinemaxhits.us.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother. (movie) - 2025

cinemaxhits.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxhits.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxhits.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxhits.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
cinemaxhits.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxhits.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxhits.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman
cinemaxhits.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (movie) - 1989

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxhits.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxhits.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 1995

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxhits.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (movie) - 1997

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
cinemaxhits.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxhits.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxhits.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (movie) - 2005

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxhits.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Nun
cinemaxhits.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxwest.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. cinemaxwest.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxwest.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Hoot
cinemaxwest.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Sessions
cinemaxwest.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun

(Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun II
cinemaxwest.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemaxwest.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxwest.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxwest.us.title: Enemy
cinemaxwest.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxwest.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: Solace
cinemaxwest.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxwest.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxwest.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemaxwest.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (Documentary) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxwest.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Lobster
cinemaxwest.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxwest.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxwest.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxwest.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemaxwest.us.title: Trance
cinemaxwest.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013
