themoviechannel.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. (Comedy) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Love, Rosie
themoviechannel.us.description: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles. (Romantic comedy) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Rules of Engagement
themoviechannel.us.description: Col. Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) is a 30-year Marine veteran: a decorated officer with combat experience in Vietnam, Beirut and Desert Storm -- a patriot, a hero. But now, the country he served so well has put him on trial for a rescue mission that went terribly wrong. For his attorney, he has chosen Marine Col. Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers. (Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. (Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Aviator
themoviechannel.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Gangs of New York
themoviechannel.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (Historical drama, Crime drama) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Double Jeopardy
themoviechannel.us.description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: 68 Kill
themoviechannel.us.description: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Before Dawn
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. (War, Historical drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (Thriller) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Godzilla
themoviechannel.us.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Red Eye
themoviechannel.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 2003

With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

trutv.us.title: Joker
trutv.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Last Summer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sandy (Barbara Hershey), Dan (Bruce Davison) and Peter (Richard Thomas) are three affluent, spoiled teens spending a lazy summer on Fire Island, N.Y. Both boys pepper Sandy with sexual advances, which she clearly relishes. Into their tight triangle comes chubby and naive Rhoda (Catherine Burns). Like the injured seagull Sandy both nurtures and tortures, Rhoda becomes a figure of sport, teased and humiliated by the group. Sandy's cruelty and influence bring the summer to a shocking climax. (Drama) - 1969

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Master of Ballantrae
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two Scottish brothers engage in fierce sibling rivalry while battling pirates, Indians and British soldiers. (Adventure) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: King Rudolf V of Ruritania (Stewart Granger) is suddenly abducted just days before his coronation is to take place. The king's evil brother, Prince Rupert (James Mason), is behind the kidnapping plot, and plans to seize the throne for himself. As the king's supporters try to find him, they stumble upon Rudolf Rassendyll (also Granger), an identical distant cousin who can pose as the betrayed ruler. The plan works well until the king's fiancée, Princess Flavia (Deborah Kerr), suspects foul play. (Adventure) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost City - Tiger Prey
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes. (Drama, Adventure)

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dark Delusion
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Gillespie's (Lionel Barrymore) young colleague (James Craig) treats an heiress (Lucille Bremer) for insanity against her family's wishes. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Out-Foxed
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Droopy is a highly civilized fox-hound. (Animated, Special, Comedy) - 1949-11-05

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Three Little Pups
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A lazy wolf targets Droopy and friends. (Animated, Comedy) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Interrupted Melody
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Biopic of Australian star Marjorie Lawrence, who took the opera world by storm and made a remarkable comeback after being crippled by polio, with the help of her devoted husband, Dr. Tim King. Starting out by singing to crippled servicemen, like herself confined to wheelchairs, she builds a new career. (Biography) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: White Heat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Gang leader Cody Jarrett (James Cagney) lives for his mother, planning heists between horrible headaches. During a train robbery that goes wrong, Cody shoots an investigator. Realizing Cody will never be stopped if he knows he's being pursued, authorities plant undercover agent Hank (Edmond O'Brien) in Cody's cell. When his mother dies, a distraught Cody breaks out of jail, bringing Hank along to join his gang. With Hank in communication with the police, Cody plans a payroll heist. (Crime drama, Action) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: San Antonio
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rancher Clay Hardin (Errol Flynn) has discovered that local saloon owner Roy Stuart (Paul Kelly) is selling cattle that doesn't belong to him, including some of Clay's own stolen stock. Armed with a tally book that proves it, Hardin now finds himself the target of Stuart's posse of gunslingers, who will stop at nothing to prevent Hardin from delivering the evidence to the proper authorities. With no one to help him except a few of his friends, Hardin has to fight for his cattle, and his life. (Western) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Take the High Ground
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sergeant Thorne Ryan fought bravely in the Korean War, and now he does his part by taking new recruits through basic training in the southern United States. A drill sergeant has to be fierce and hated by his trainees, but is Ryan the monster he is thought to be? (War) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: American Pop
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This animated trek across the musical landscape of the 20th century begins with young immigrant Zalmie arriving in New York City. He's addicted to show business, but an accident ruins his voice. He marries a stripper and their son, Benny, becomes a jazz pianist. Although Benny is killed in World War II, his son, Tony, goes on to great success as a songwriter during the '60s, as does Tony's son, Pete (also Thompson), in the '80s. (Animated, Musical) - 1981

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Fame
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young men and women audition for coveted spots at the New York High School of Performing Arts. Those who make the cut discover that it takes a lot of hard work to become a star and sometimes difficult decisions have to be made. The youngsters grapple with heavy issues such as homosexuality, abortion, attempted suicide and illiteracy. On top of their unique struggles, the students must deal with the mundane pressures of adolescence like homework, heartbreak and rejection. (Musical) - 1980

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Nora Prentiss
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended. (Crime drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Jack L. Warner: The Last Mogul
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rising from humble beginnings, Jack L. Warner and his brothers make movie history by founding Warner Bros. Studios. (Documentary, Biography) - 1993

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: To Have and Have Not
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In Vichy France, fishing boat captain Harry (Humphrey Bogart) avoids getting involved in politics, refusing to smuggle French Resistance fighters into Martinique. But when a Resistance client is shot before he can pay, Harry agrees to help hotel owner Gerard (Marcel Dalio) smuggle two fighters to the island. Harry is further swayed by Slim (Lauren Bacall), a wandering American girl, and when the police take his friend Eddie (Walter Brennan) hostage, he is forced to fight for the Resistance. (Adventure, Romantic comedy) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ladies They Talk About
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A district attorney feels a strong attraction for an imprisoned gun moll who rises to the top of the prison ladder. (Drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lady Gangster
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dot Burton wants to be an actress, but is stuck working as a decoy for bank robber Carey Wells and his crooks. After a big heist, Dot realizes that the boys plan to keep her share of the money. Angry at her partners and tired of crime, she hides the loot from Wells, intending to return it to the bank herself, but, before she can, she's thrown in jail for her involvement in the stickup. However, even the walls of a prison can't stop Wells from coming after Dot. (Crime drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lady Scarface
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A police detective (Dennis O'Keefe) and his photographer girlfriend (Frances Neal) hunt a gang led by a woman (Judith Anderson). (Crime drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Nora Prentiss
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended. (Crime drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Secret Garden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Orphaned Mary Lennox (Margaret O'Brien) arrives at the Yorkshire mansion of her mysterious Uncle Craven (Herbert Marshall). Bitter and confused after the death of her parents, she clashes with the other residents of the estate, including the surly housekeeper (Gladys Cooper), the giggling maid (Elsa Lanchester) and Craven's invalid son (Dean Stockwell). After discovering a key to a secret garden, Mary seeks the means to heal herself and the other inhabitants of the Craven household. (Children, Drama) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Great Sinner
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When accomplished novelist Fedja becomes enamored of the stunningly beautiful and mysterious Pauline on a train to Paris, he abandons his plans and instead goes with her to a German casino. Fascinated by the people he meets there and wanting to remain near Pauline, he decides to study the gamblers as research for his next book. Pauline, however, is a consummate gambler herself, and her addiction slowly pulls Fedja into a world of corruption and lost luck. (Drama) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Marriage on the Rocks

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Boys' Night Out
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After seeing their boss with his mistress, four work friends (James Garner, Tony Randall, Howard Duff, Howard Morris) decide they should get a gentleman's pad in the city. When Fred (Garner), the only bachelor in the group, rents an apartment for their dalliances, he meets gorgeous Cathy (Kim Novak), whom he hires to be their "housekeeper." Cathy lets them all make plays for her, but has no intention of sleeping with them -- she is merely doing research for her sociology thesis. (Comedy) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Incendiary Blonde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1909, lively Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) attends a Wild West show and, dressing like a man, enters a bucking bronco contest and wins. Impressed by her audacity, the show's manager, Bill (Arturo de Córdova), hires her. In order to help support her family, Texas joins the rodeo and thrills the audience with her daredevil act. Texas and Bill soon fall in love, but Bill refuses to marry her, so Texas leaves the show for the bright lights of Broadway -- not realizing that Bill hides a secret. (Musical) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this wacky Preston Sturges comedy, the soldier-smitten Trudy Kockenlocker (Betty Hutton) discovers that she is both married and pregnant after a raucous troop send-off party. While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law. (Comedy) - 1944

abcsydney.au.description: S1 E1 Central Station, Sydney Our journey begins at Sydney's Central Station where we meet some extraordinary Australians with a beautiful piano talent.

abcsydney.au.description: S3 E3 Cangai Siege After a spree of murders across NSW and QLD, three criminals, with two child hostages, holed up inside an empty farmhouse outside Cangai in northern NSW. Their one goal was to challenge police to a shootout to the death.

abcsydney.au.title: Mark Of A Murderer
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E2 The Palm Print A police cold case review uncovers a palm print proving Andrew Mallard wasn't Pamela Lawrence's killer. Is this offender also guilty of other murders?

actionmax.us.title: Parental Guidance
actionmax.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (Children, Comedy) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: The East
actionmax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
actionmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

actionmax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
actionmax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Alto Knights
actionmax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Aniara
actionmax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Predator
actionmax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
actionmax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Scream
actionmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

actionmax.us.title: Shut In
actionmax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: The Watchers
actionmax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Trap
actionmax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Black Butterfly
actionmax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
actionmax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Science fiction) - 1956

actionmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

actionmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
actionmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
actionmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

actionmax.us.title: Scanners
actionmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

actionmax.us.title: It
actionmax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

actionmax.us.title: Life of Pi
actionmax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: Take the Lead
actionmax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

actionmax.us.title: Room
actionmax.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (Drama, Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
actionmax.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
actionmax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Arctic
actionmax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Beirut
moremax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
moremax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

moremax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band

moremax.us.title: Hall Pass

To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Companion
moremax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Thriller, Science fiction, Horror, Dark comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Bring Her Back

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde

With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
moremax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Game Night
moremax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Comedy, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip

Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Batman
moremax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

moremax.us.title: Batman Returns
moremax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Batman Forever
moremax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

moremax.us.title: Batman & Robin
moremax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled

It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. tvasports.ca.title: Canada in the Rough ᴺᵉʷ
tvasports.ca.description: Cette émission canadienne de chasse présente les majestueuses montagnes Rocheuses de la Colombie-Britanique, les horizons sans fin des Prairies, les mystérieux marais de Terre-Neuve, la mystique forêt boréale du Bouclier Canadien en Ontario et la beauté désertique de l'Arctique. Chaque semaine, une chasse extraordinaire pour une espèce différente de gibier est présentée. Chaque épisode s'efforce d'éduquer, d'informer et de divertir à travers l'équilibre unique de l'expérience de chasse combinée aux interactions humaine et biologique avec les espèces chassées. (Outdoors, Hunting) - 2005-07-03

tvasports.ca.title: Le guide de l'auto - Lincoln Navigator
tvasports.ca.description: L'équipe met à l'essai le nouveau Lincoln Navigator ; pour sa cinquième génération, le Lincoln Navigator reçoit une dose de style et de technologie, mais est-ce suffisant pour le rendre meilleur que le Cadillac Escalade ? L'équipe en fait l'analyse. (Auto) - 2026-05-16

tvasports.ca.title: L'académie du guide de l'auto: formule Grand Prix - Deux fortes têtes, une petite voiture: ça va décoiffer!
tvasports.ca.description: Ne vous fiez pas à son format: la surprenante Chevrolet Bolt pourrait bien réserver de grosses surprises à Lévi Doré et Oussama Fares; les deux artistes s'affrontent sur la piste dans un duel où agilité et puissance sous le capot seront de mise; Antoine Joubert nous présente ensuite notre véhicule de la semaine; puis, Rosalie Bonenfant nous entraîne en Éthiopie, à la découverte d'un pays aux paysages grandioses et aux idées étonnantes. (Auto, Reality) - 2026-11-14

Hosts Sara Gore and George Oliphant (who also rescues homeowners' renovation projects on sister show "George to the Rescue," which began as a segment of "Open House" before becoming a stand-alone show) showcase some of the hottest homes on the market in major cities, get interior design tips from experts and provide information on what people need to know about stylish living. (How-to, House/garden, Home improvement) - 2009-07-04

wmaq.us.title: Open House Outrageous
wmaq.us.description: Open House Outrageous is a new series co-hosted by interior designer Megan Batoon and comedian Tim Chantarangsu. Friends and adventure junkies, Megan and Tim hit the road to discover some of America's most unique vacation properties and meet the creative minds behind them. From Highland castles and homes built under airplanes to hobbit homes and earth domes. They'll explore incredible spaces, uncover their stories and find out what makes each stay truly one of a kind. Along the way, Megan brings her expert eye for design while Tim brings the fun, as they search for the ultimate unforgettable vacation stay. Get ready for an Outrageous adventure! (Travel) - 2026-10-24

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Sri Lanka And Bali In Sri Lanka, Rick Stein discovers a wealth of spicy vegetable curries. In Colombo, he meets one the country's most respected chefs and tastes an unforgettable chilli crab.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Into the Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Food Whisperer Alex Dilling changed the world is how a 2 Michelin star chef has described him. There was an explosion of the best dishes anyone had seen anywhere.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour: South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Gary Barlow With Special Guest Eliot Kennedy Gary begins his South African adventure, meeting his best friend and fellow musician Eliot Kennedy in Franschhoek.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Justine arrives in Lofoten Islands, joining the founders of Lofoten Seaweed to forage along the shoreline before turning the harvest into a stunning dish-scallops with a seaweed beurre noisette.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 Episode 1 Paula enjoys fried catfish with Dolly Parton's sister Rachel, and visits the rodeo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: How To Cook Well In Morocco
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Chefchaouen Tucked under the Rif mountains which gave it protection from the waves of marauding invaders, Chefchaouen is famous for its gorgeous blue buildings. By good fortune.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E3 Stephen Colbert And Evie McGee-Colbert The amazing talk show host, comedian, writer and producer Stephen Colbert and his wife, Producer Evie McGee Colbert are joining Ina for a wonderful day at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Homo Gastronomicus
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Tomato After vanilla, Francois-Regis Gaudry continues his exploration of taste, setting out to discover those universal foods that make our mouths water.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Bites With Hebridean Baker
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Gotland In Sweden's Gotland, Coinneach helps pick asparagus, make saffron pancake, ramslok soup and drikka.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Christmas At The Castle
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Christmas Pork And Furry Friends A Magical Christmas Downunder to life with Doggylicious treats for pets, Char Sui Pork Bao Buns for the humans, and magical mallow and sprinkles hot chocolate for the kids.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 Episode 1 Paula enjoys fried catfish with Dolly Parton's sister Rachel, and visits the rodeo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Piedmont It's mid-winter and Jamie is high up in the snow-capped Italian Alps seeking out Piedmont's legendary comfort food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tour De Fred: Northern Ireland
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Strangford Fred Sirieix's journey in Northern Ireland takes him along Strangford Lough's scenic shores. He cycles from Castle Ward to Portaferry, by land and sea routes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Billy And Dom Eat The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Scotland Billy takes Dom to his northern homeland of Scotland to see a very different side of Britain.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Justine arrives in Lofoten Islands, joining the founders of Lofoten Seaweed to forage along the shoreline before turning the harvest into a stunning dish-scallops with a seaweed beurre noisette.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 Episode 1 Paula enjoys fried catfish with Dolly Parton's sister Rachel, and visits the rodeo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Bites With Hebridean Baker
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Gotland In Sweden's Gotland, Coinneach helps pick asparagus, make saffron pancake, ramslok soup and drikka.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Homo Gastronomicus
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Tomato After vanilla, Francois-Regis Gaudry continues his exploration of taste, setting out to discover those universal foods that make our mouths water.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E15 When You Fish Upon A Star Mary helps you master the catch of the day with recipes focused around fish, including zesty tuna tartare and curried salmon en papillote.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E10 All In The Skillet Weeknights are skillet nights! Lidia prepares dishes from the skillet or poured onto a family-style platter. Like: shrimp with asparagus, gratinate of pork, eggplant, and zucchini, and soft polenta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania Will journeys to Italy's picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Over 100 Years Old Buddy visits two legendary restaurants that have been open for over 100 years, McGillin's Old Ale House in Philadelphia, and Katz's Deli in New York City!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Market Day It's the weekly market in Sophie's town, her favourite day of the week. She makes zucchini alla poverella, then learns about stuffed aubergines, and asparagus frittata.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Ost Danmark (Denmark) East Denmark contains some of Denmark's most fertile lands, and many formerly traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their specialist cheeses and wine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Homecoming To Mer Island Join acclaimed Torres Strait Islander chef and cultural ambassador Nornie Bero in Island Echoes, a vibrant journey through the breathtaking landscapes and rich traditions of her homeland.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E27 Citrus It's citrus season so Maggie Beer and Simon Bryant add a tang to everything from curry to bread and butter pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E41 Episode 41 Laura heads to the beautiful Barossa Valley, where a delicious Pear and Frangipane Tart is on the menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E11 Sloppy Joes Rachael puts a flavourful spin on the classic American favourite, Sloppy Joes, by sauteing a savory mix of ground beef and beef chorizo with fresh vegetables and bold seasonings.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E3 Episode 3 Chef Luca Ciano delivers the ultimate in recipe inspiration with his fresh and original Italian style creations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Beef And Chorizo Chili With Queso Inspired by her friend Brian, Rachael shows how to make her version of a beef and chorizo chili with queso that is the perfect meal for a holiday crowd, a big game night, or a family dinner.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E36 Episode 36 Laura makes the Prahran Market her kitchen to show off a Crispy Potato Salad that breaks all potato salad conventions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Carrots And Beets Purple, white and gold carrots, pink and white striped beetroots. The garden throws up a multicoloured feast of beautiful carrots and beets that form the basis of Jamie's recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E65 Episode 65 Matt Stone leaves nothing to waste with his Beetroot Roots, Stalks & Leaves recipe. Justine then shows you how easy it is to make tasty Saffron Arancini Stuffed with Bocconcini.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E11 Nature's Finest Shout out to Mother Nature as Restaurant Botanic's Justin James and Vola Foods's Ashely Vola join Adam to make fantastic food with nature's finest ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 One of the most dramatic and beautiful fjords in the world. Justine finds a spot on deck to make fresh waffles with brown cheese.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Perfect Bite At Austin's La Barbecue, Jess learns brisket sandwich essentials before creating her own smoky version at home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Truffles & Herbs Tom Kerridge is truffle foraging in Umbria before discovering the precision farming that produces Campania's herbs and cooking up delicious dishes celebrating them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E77 The Great Big Garden Show / The Sea Sniffles Ariel wants her plant to grow too quickly. Flounder fakes being sick.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie + Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Xylophone While donating some old items to Higgledy Heros charity shop, Maddie has doubts about giving away her old xylophone - can she really let go of her very first musical instrument?!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E41 Fox Cubs There is a new fox cub leader in The Little Kingdom. It's Nanny Plum, also known as Fluffy Owl. Whilst attempting to earn their adventure badges the fox cubs find themselves stuck at the top of Mount Everest with no way down.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E32 Best Bounty Buddies The Jedi help two bounty hunters work together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Heroes Everywhere An asteroid heads for earth, with the power to turn our heroes into villains. But help arrives from an unexpected source.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Mountain River Cave A huge storm in Vietnam sends floodwaters into a nearby cave, trapping Ryla, Kwazii, Shellington and a tiger. Thankfully, a cave-dwelling woodlouse helps them find their way out before the tiger catches up with them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S26 E10 Blackout! A storm knocks out power, Thomas volunteers to deliver a generator from Kellsthorpe to Knapford. He's determined to complete this task on his own, but realises the delivery route has complications he can't handle by himself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E29 Nine's Time To Shine The Nine Times Table shows how you can add ten and take one away, to make Nine's friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 Pool Party Pants and Popcorn know just how to beat the heat, with a pool party! They invite everyone over, but playing in the water isn't something their friends do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fantus And The Machines
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Asphalt Paver Have you ever wondered how a road is paved? Find out with Fantus as he sees how an asphalt paver works.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Ballet Lesson Peppa is excited about her very first ballet lesson and decides to teach Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and George how to dance. She is surprised to learn that Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig know a few ballet moves of their own.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E18 Lucia The Drumming Superstar Lucia is on a quest to find her special drumming suit, the one that makes her feel like a superstar, but it's nowhere to be found-not even in the Wiggly Kitchen! Can The Wiggles help her find it?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E12 Checklist Bitzer's over-officious management style becomes too much for the sheep who decide it's time for him to chill out. Bitzer's tasks for the day takes on a new purpose, for everyone to have some fun!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Spin Rushes In When Doc Ock steals the arachno-sting power Team Spidey has to get it back before it puts the town to sleep.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Tin Can Games It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Wacky Weather / Kittydale Racers Lab Rat creates wacky weather that threatens to ruin the Pawesome Picnic. When the Kittydale Race gets sabotaged, Bitsy stops racing to help the SuperKitties save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 The Elf Windmill King Thistle wants bread for his Royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes Holly, Ben and Nanny Plum to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 Flour's Fun List Flower writes a Pet Day 'fun list' for Flour, but quickly discovers that letting him choose his own fun is way better than sticking to a list.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Earworm A mysterious song gets stuck in Flower and Flour's heads, and their quest to shake it reveals a special musical bond between Flower, Penny, and Por Por.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E53 Canoe Trip Peppa and her family are going on a canoe trip. They hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit and head down river on their canoe adventure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E54 The Holiday Peppa and her family have gone on holiday. They are staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Mount Mumandad Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad! But facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots, this will take teamwork.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 Kids A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and Dad is a very naughty boy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E16 The Hole Banana The Bananaraptors fall into a deep hole and Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes must think of a clever and creative way to get them out safely.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E15 Slee-Pea Heads Ginger is leading the Baby Pea-Rexes home through a shortcut and gets lost, refusing to admit defeat, she suggests they find an even better bed to spend the night!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Second Opinion Mara visits the clinic with an unusually curly fin but the doctors don't agree on the diagnosis. Can Zog reunite Pearl and Gadabout to work together on the cure?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 The Puppy Badge Duggee's nephew Dudley comes to stay. He's one cute puppy, but he looks like he could cause chaos in the clubhouse. The Squirrels come up with lots of imaginative ways to entertain him!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Calm Down Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! And grown-up Tag, a firefighter, splashes loads around. Good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E27 Painting Seasons With Costa's help and the power of their imaginations, the junior gardeners choose a plant each and paint it across four seasons.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Sensational Senses
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S378 E2 Listen and Balance Alex, Rachael and Vanessa, along with Auslan Translator Julia, learn all about the senses of sound and balance. Rachael teaches yoga, they make popping popcorn, and the toys listen to a thunderstorm.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Potluck Picnic Wilf thinks he's been left out of a picnic, so he sulks and builds a huge tower. The Piggies must convince him to join them before the tower collapses.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 The Treasure Of El Bravo After Enrique steals the heart of El Bravo, there's only one person who can help Santi and crew save the day: Tomas's younger sister, Prima Tina!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S0 E6 Peppa Pig: Peppa's Pumpkin Party Daddy Pig is throwing a special party. Everyone is invited, and they are all dressing in scary costumes. Peppa is a witch, George is a dinosaur, Rebecca Rabbit is a carrot gone bad!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig: The Golden Boots
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Mrs Duck seems to have taken a liking to Peppa's golden boots and runs away with them! Can Peppa track down the golden boots before the big puddle jump competition?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Tree Of Wisdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 The Rattlin' Bog Dance along with him and the Little Tree of Wisdom and then learn about hula hooping! Can you shake your hips and give it a go? And don't miss the remix of the hit song 'The Rattlin' Bog'!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Nikhil and Jay and the Lucky Striker When Jay plays carrom with Ammamma's lucky striker he can finally beat Amma! But when Jay loses the lucky striker his winning streak ends. Nikhil has a plan to help his brother!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 The Most Magnificent Pet Show Millie, Ben and Maya set out to teach Ying Ying a flying trick for the pet show in the park.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Hole in the Fence Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Mini Miffy Miffy's delight at being imitated by Baby Bun turns to frustration when his constant mimicry interferes with her dance recital practice, leading her on a journey to understand the joys and challenges of being a big sister!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Mayor Mittens When Mayor Sourdough appoints Mittens as mayor of Kibble Corners (just while he takes a nap, mind you) everything goes wrong very fast.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Puppy Party Pants worries that having adoptive bunny parents might not make him puppy enough for a puppy party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 Simon's Rosy Arrangement Simon is crafting a floral arrangement for Dorothy the Dinosaur, but his roses vanish when he steps away to get some water. Caterina calls Fiore Enzo, the detective specialist for help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Today Fantus meets a pigeon, a rat and a badger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Percy's Lucky Bell When Thomas borrows Percy's lucky bell for a dangerous delivery, Thomas isn't careful and loses the bell.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E12 Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E13 World Book Day It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Shaun The Farmer The Farmer is sick in bed, so, with Bitzer playing nurse-maid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm - with disastrous results.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Chillipede Chase Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Giants in the Meadow Lucy's dad is digging up the meadow and the Little Kingdom is in danger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Hectic Robot When a robotic toy duck is left at the restaurant, Flower becomes obsessed. Meanwhile, Flour the cat struggles to compete with the quacking newcomer for her attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 Tiny Trouble When Cat Burglar shrinks Buddy on his way to steal musical instruments, Buddy learns that he doesn't have to be big to be super.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E45 The Kitty Cat Caper Bonnie's cat tricks the crew into thinking he's a good pirate, but then they realize he's actually after their treasure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E23 Gekko Vs Armavillian Desperate to prove himself, Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E20 The Octonauts And Hammerhead Sharks The Octonauts study a group of baby hammerhead sharks, as they hunt on their own for the first time and poke their noses into trouble.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 The Sand Castle Badge It's a lovely warm day for the beach. The squirrels learn how to make sand castles. They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel the crabs ask if the squirrels could work together to build them a new home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dad Rescue When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S13 E6 Too Many Peas, Too Many Plugs When Dilys overloads a socket at the Cut Price Store and starts a fire, Mandy learns that every job on the Fire Rescue team is the most important job!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 Nikhil and Jay and the Sneezies When Amma gets the sneezies, Nikhil and Jay are worried that it's Max's fault. They try to stop their cat from being sent away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E4 What's My Number? Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Makery
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Laundry Day Nim makes a sock gobbling monster by recycling an old box. Once the washing is done, she cooks focaccia flowers and creates a puppet mouse out of old clothes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Cows Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E18 Everyday Helpers: 3 Abi and Luke meet Ben, a friendly and helpful nurse! Luke uses craft materials to make his own stethoscope, and Jemima visits Dr Kiya at hospital for an x-ray! Through The Windows, we see more medical workers in an animation.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Highway Rat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E1 Two Truths Little J is torn between Ms Chen and Nanna's knowledge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy and the Band
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E2 Dinosaur Football It's time to get back to Rock Star School. But with Evil Aliens, Dinosaurs, Football and Cheesy Puffs, Andy faces a tough task to keep everyone from getting distracted.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dodge's Pup School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 The Class Star Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he out shine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers that the real key to winning the Class Star award is by trying his best.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Sleepyhead Dirk promises to read Flower and Flour a bedtime story but when he's too tired to continue, Flower has to step in and invent her own bedtime story.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E20 Sensory Garden Hannah works with two brothers to create a garden that delights all of the senses. Alfie is vision impaired and loves being active and playing, so they create a garden of games he can enjoy with his brother, William.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S10 E5 Granny Sheep Moves In Suzy's grandma, Granny Sheep, moves into her house for the first time ever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Cardboard Boxes Peppa and her friends have fun playing with boxes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Big BIG Lifty Pod Andrew's fear of heights stops him from riding the Lifty Pod - but he doesn't want to miss out on hill sliding with his friends. So, when the littlecorns share how they face their fears, Andrew finds a way to be brave, too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Sodor Sings Together
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Yoga Ball Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Gadabout Blabbermouth Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: MaeBee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake While helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing, becoming 500yrs old. A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure, that's if they can catch it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Moment of Tooth After reading comics, Buns is convinced a super carrot will give her superpowers. But rescuing her sister Blossom's lost tooth is what makes her a true superhero!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Super-Fan SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Space Creature When Wizz finds a friendly Space Creature on his couch, he has no choice but to try and help her get back to her home before the Fun Suckers find her and put her in space prison.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E16 Army Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat,Â but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Milk Bar Rory has forgotten his lunch, again, and the other children have had enough. They refuse to give him any more of their food. Rory is starving and, in desperation, decides to go to the milk bar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Trials The Crooklings compete at the cutthroat Trials, with the eyes of the Crooked world watching. The Nameless spy resorts to desperate measures. Jia leads the search for Amira.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 The Tale of the Danse Macabre On the eve of the school dance, the Midnight Society wrestles with the possibility that evil still lurks among them and the nightmare is far from over.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Secret Life Of Bees
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Steve finds out about the importance of Britain's wild bees and discovers exactly how the National Bee Unit are trying to eradicate the dreaded Asian hornet - a bee-eating machine - from the UK.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Zapped The MythBusters test if you can be electrocuted by lightning while talking on the phone; if a stun-gun could use water instead of wires; and if peeing on the electrified rail of a subway line could give you a fatal shock.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Vikings This time The Slow Mo Guys go conquering and look at the amazing world of Vikings. What happens when strong Viking swords strike together?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Grand Final The heat winners in shows 1 to 5 come back to fight again. The judges must choose one Wild Card from the runners-up to join them. Every team left standing battles it out to make it to the grand final of Robot Wars.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E3 A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E66 Raheim Brown Jr 16-year-old 'RJ' Brown Jnr has just made his NBL debut as a Development Player for the Adelaide 36ers. We find out what it's like to be youngest player signed by an NBL club in more than 40 years.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E38 Cruisin' For a Losin' May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 A Message From The Future The Incursion Of Goku Black! After regaining consciousness, Future Trunks describes how he came to arrive in the present. But apparently not even the gods are allowed to meddle with the past. Bulma and Future Trunks might have a bit of explaining to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Baby Bears Can't Jump Charlie hosts an evening of spooky stories.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upstart Crow
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 The Quality Of Mercy There's money to be made investing in cargos from the New World: but while Marlowe invests in tobacco and potato products, Will would rather invest in building a new theatre. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E3 Text When Lee mistakenly sends a rude text about Anna to Lucy, he makes the stupid mistake of sending it to Anna herself. Lee and Lucy now face the onerous task of stealing Anna's phone and deleting the text before she reads it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 Swansea Phil is in the coastal city of Swansea, giving advice to owners who want to sell properties which include a four bedroom end of terrace house and a four bedroom Edwardian property.
