ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E7 No Kids Paul and Ally are disappointed that their family holiday becomes just the two of them, but they soon make new friends. Luke is preparing for his new life with Maya and makes a decision which leaves them both terrified.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E8 No Control Paul and Ally rush to fly back from their holiday when they hear that Maya is giving birth five weeks early. Ava and Sunil try to help Luke step up and become a father, but everyone is in shock when complications set in.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E9 No Matter What: Part 1 As Paul and Ally try to help Luke, struggling with being a dad and a student, they find they have very different ideas about the best way forward. Jackie's condition becomes more noticeable, and Jim is determined to help out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ABC News Update
ABCMESydney.au.description: E94 Monday 23 November 2026 The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Aviation The panellists in this episode are willing and able to make a noise, and they are: Alan Davies, Australia's Julia Morris, Rich Hall and Peter Serafinowicz.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E18 Susan Strong Finn and Jake meet some humans living underground. Except, they find the Candy People irresistible.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E29 A Real Crayon The Bears find a mysterious crayon that has the power to make anything they draw become REAL.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E49 Girls Night In Part 1 The Girls Night Out crew decide to stay in and have a slumber party, but an unknown alien threat descends on Jump City.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 The Ghost Of Christmas Present (part 1) It's Christmas Eve and the last day of term at Malory Towers. Everyone is excited! Darrell is disappointed that her parents have been delayed due to bad weather and that she'll have to stay at school for Christmas.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E35 The Three Stooges Save Christmas Pt. 1 The kids accidentally destroy Chef's decorated Christmas tree. Scared this means they've ruined his Christmas, they go on an epic mission to replace his holiday treasures.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Spoooooky Game In this Halloween episode, the gang’s weekly board game night has been getting a little too competitive lately, so when Unikitty finds a spooky old board game that’s clearly haunted, their desire to win gets turned on its head.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 The First Day Best friends Oscar and Hedgehog get dropped off at their first day at summer camp.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 New Order Ken's out and Sandra is officially in charge of OME. If RADI8 wants to debut, they'll have to prove to her that they've got what it takes to shine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E36 The Spheal of Approval A day of relaxation in Slateport City turns into a confrontation between Team Rocket and Team Magma!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E45 BBCYFSHIPBDAY Beast Boy and Cyborg celebrate the birthday of their friendship.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E11 Tiny Outburst Society After discovering that young Mortimer doesn't have any friends, Oscar helps him start a new club on campus. But the monsters are forced to hide their newfound friendship from the school - and Stuart.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 The Vacation Jim and Bianca set off on an improvised camping trip in the desert. With no real plan for water, Cyril secretly tags along to keep an eye on them - but how long can he stay hidden in the shadows?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E33 Melter Skelter When Chef tells Beth he won't buy the new super amazing toy she wants because they already have plenty to play with, she goes on a mission to get rid of their toys.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 More Things In Heaven And Earth Clark agonizes over what to do for his and Lois' first Valentine's Day. until visions of his father lead him, Jimmy, and Lois to the remains of his Spaceship and the new villains of Task Force X!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Journeys
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E6 Working My Way Back to Mew! With Scorbunny by his side, Goh decides on a new goal-catch every kind of Pokemon!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Dance Wizz has promised his friend Nessie that he will perform a dance with her at the end of the show, but he is very nervous and doesn't want any extra eyeballs watching!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Shaun The Sheep: Brain Breaks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Help Gran It's Granny V Shaun in this boisterous battle of wits! Get ready to throw and run as you help Granny to hit the moving targets with her ball of wool - the more you give it, the better her aim!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 Rainy Day Bears Can Arty light up all four squares on the dancefloor before the time runs out? With some help from The Moving Crew, Arty manages to get the disco going!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E25 Grey Black and White colour a city with new the help of new friend Grey. Learn to mix different shades of grey with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E25 Octonaughty and the Fractionator Octonaughty uses his new invention, the Fractionator, to break into The Museum of Numbers to steal the Golden Infinity. But has he met his match when he splits Octoblock into four equal parts?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Slime Storm! When Power Paige accidentally causes a Slime Storm, Super Why gets stuck!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E9 Traffic Lights Maddie is looking at useful lights. She shows us how traffic lights work so that vehicles can safely travel through a road junction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E25 Gross and Smelly Lots of things in the garden seem a bit gross - compost, slugs, spider webs, poo, worms, but all have a purpose. And Costa will prove that the purpose is. beautiful!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E9 Urine Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at the bladder and show you how to make a wee machine in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Vibrobot Vibration is the idea behind a shaky vibrobot - one maxed out enough so Phil can ride it! Plus: spinning an 8-foot coin, suspending water in mid-air and lasers!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Physics House
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Can I Bend Spoons With My Mind? Are people really capable of bending spoons with their minds? Will Yanick be able to work out the physics behind metal fatigue before he breaks every spoon in the Physics House kitchen?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Ice Cream Dr Karl gets the scoop on how two of our most popular ice creams are made. Australians each devour around 18 litres of ice cream a year, making us the third largest population of ice cream eaters on the planet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E3 Wedding Cake Folly and a Circular House A garden room designed from a modernist house and a hand built wooden caravan feature, along with a wedding cake folly.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E4 Friend Lucy worries that Lee is becoming isolated, so he vows to make more of an effort to chat to parents in the school playground, but makes the mistake of striking up a friendship with Keith, a man even less sociable than he is.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 A group of conspirators has been deliberately de-stabilising Britain - can the team preserve the status quo?

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Laura, Daniel, and son Archie have moved to Mersea Island in Essex where she grew up. But converting an old beach house into a family home, on a tiny 50,000 pound budget, pushes Dan to breaking point. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E4 When The Bough Breaks A school bus crash floods the ER with severely injured children. A crack-addicted woman who didn't know she was pregnant delivers a stillborn baby. Mark's ex-wife tells him he can't see Rachel until he's got his act together.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Danger Joining QI master Stephen Fry are Sean Lock, Jimmy Carr, Jo Brand and Alan Davies. It's the first episode of series D and the theme is danger.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E6 Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza & Jeremy Vine Rob Brydon is back as host, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza and Jeremy Vine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E7 Episode 7 Adam and Jamie test the myth that a convinct sandwiched between two cops survived after their car was T’boned, while Kari Tory and Grant, find out if \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Orpington Phil goes to in south east London, meeting the owners of properties which seem stuck on the market, including a three bedroom semi-detached property and a larger than average property in a sought after cul de sac. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E4 Off-Roader, Luxury Cabin and a Skip A couple create an off roader from an army lorry and an old caravan, and a man builds a luxury cabin on the family farm.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E36 Former winners Dane Baptiste, Richard Herring, June Sarpong and Kate Williams test their general knowledge skills on this week's Richard Osman's House of Games: Champions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E18 Vance Joy, Lara Mulcahy, Dave O'Neil & Denise Scott Joining Josh, Ella and Adam are singer/songwriter and triple J's latest Hottest 100 winner Vance Joy, the highly talented star of the upcoming production of Les Mis, Lara Mulcahy plus comedians Dave O'Neil and Denise Scott.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S22 E14 Victory Join Sandi Toksvig and the QI team in search of Victory with Rob Beckett, Daliso Chaponda, Lara Ricote, and Alan Davies. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E1 Jo Brand, Russell Howard, Larry Lamb, Carol Vorderman Carol Vorderman, Larry Lamb, Jo Brand and Russell Howard join team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack to hoodwink their opponents with absurd facts and plausible lies about themselves.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E15 Waiter, There's a Confetti In My Magic Featured magicians include Laurent Piron, Mark Clearview, Glenn West and Abby Segal.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E5 The Mind of Evil: Episode 1 At Stangmoor Prison, the Doctor and Jo watch a demonstration of the Keller Machine which can extract evil impulses from criminals. But the experiment goes wrong and a man dies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E6 The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E7 The Mind of Evil: Episode 3 The Master is behind the Keller Machine and uses it to recruit the rioting inmates at Stangmoor Prison. He plans to capture a missile and fire it at the World Peace Conference.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E8 The Mind of Evil: Episode 4 The mind parasite within the Keller Machine becomes too powerful for the Master to control. It learns how to move of its own accord and goes on the hunt for new minds.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E9 The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E10 The Mind of Evil: Episode 6 The Keller Machine breaks free of the Doctor’s restraining device and the Doctor has no choice but to turn the parasite against the Master.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E11 The Claws of Axos: Episode 1 Axos lands on Earth. The Axons ask only to be allowed to repair their damaged ship and offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite in return. But the Axons aren’t all that they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E12 The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E13 The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E14 The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E8 The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E5 The Daleks: The Dead Planet The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world. Everything is dead but beyond a petrified jungle they see a huge metal city which the Doctor is determined to explore.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E7 The Daleks: The Escape Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals. Realising that the Daleks are planning an ambush, the four travellers try to escape and warn the Thals.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E9 The Daleks: The Expedition Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city from the unguarded mountains behind it. Their journey is a dangerous one and not all will survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E10 The Daleks: The Ordeal The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks. In the mountains, Ian, Barbara and the Thals must negotiate a vast chasm to reach the city.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E11 The Daleks: The Rescue The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks from all sides as the Daleks start the countdown to release deadly doses of radiation into the atmosphere.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E6 The Daleks: The Survivors Looking for Barbara, the Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to lethal doses of radiation. The travellers are confronted by the city’s inhabitants – the Daleks!

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E13 The Edge of Destruction: The Brink of Disaster As the power of the TARDIS threatens to escape and destroy the ship, the travellers become increasingly paranoid and hostile towards each other.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E12 The Edge of Destruction: The Edge of Destruction The TARDIS is suspended in space and the Doctor, Ian, Barbara and Susan are confused and frightened by a series of inexplicable events.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E25 The Keys of Marinus: Sentence of Death Arriving in the city of Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes on the role of defence counsel and must prove Ian's innocence or he will be executed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E26 The Keys of Marinus: The Keys of Marinus The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key. With Ian now free, the travellers return to the island only to discover that Arbitan has been murdered.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

oxygenwest.us.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder

oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E01 Thanks-killing Earl and Terry Robertson are found brutally murdered in their home just before Thanksgiving; investigating whether this is a holiday robbery gone terribly wrong, or a crime committed by someone the couple knew and trusted.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler

oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E06 Stand Your Ground A teacher hosting a family birthday party is shot dead by an angry neighbor who captures the confrontation on camera; the shooter claims the video proves self-defense, but prosecutors say it shows he staged the showdown to get away with murder.

Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals. (Science, Nature, Educational) - 2016-09-05

fxm.us.title: Two for the Road
fxm.us.description: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart. (movie) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
fxm.us.description: Lorelei Lee (Marilyn Monroe) is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond (Tommy Noonan), much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage. (movie) - 1953

fxm.us.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular
fxm.us.description: A showgirl from the San Francisco cabaret is murdered, and the only witnesses are fellow showgirls Stormy Tornado (Betty Grable) and Curly Flagg (Sheree North). Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown. (movie) - 1955

fxm.us.title: 9 to 5
fxm.us.description: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant. (movie) - 1980

fxm.us.title: Working Girl
fxm.us.description: Savvy New York City receptionist Tess McGill (Melanie Griffith) gives her conniving boss, Katharine Parker (Sigourney Weaver), an excellent business tip, but Katharine simply steals the idea without giving due credit to her secretary. After Katharine winds up in the hospital with an injured leg, Tess decides to exact revenge. Pretending to be her boss, Tess initiates a major deal with an investment broker (Harrison Ford) -- but things turn ugly after Katharine finds out what Tess has been up to. (movie) - 1988

fxm.us.title: Moulin Rouge
fxm.us.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 2001

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads
cinevault.us.description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

cinevault.us.title: The Baby-Sitters Club
cinevault.us.description: Kristy Thomas and her six best friends struggle to make their successful business -- the Baby-Sitters Club -- into a full-fledged summer day camp. When a group of adults led by their crotchety neighbor, Emily Haberman, tries to shut down the camp, the girls must band together to keep their dream alive. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy. (Children, Drama, Movie) - 1995-08-18

cinevault.us.title: Annie
cinevault.us.description: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds. (Children, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1982-05-20

cinevault.us.title: The Green Hornet
cinevault.us.description: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz). (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2011-01-14

cinevault.us.title: Blue Streak
cinevault.us.description: When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 1999-09-17

cinevault.us.title: The Buddy Holly Story
cinevault.us.description: A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies. (Biography, Movie, Music, Rock) - 1978-05-18

circlecountry.us.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
circlecountry.us.description: Bad guy Butch Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) leads an ambush on the Texas Rangers, gunning down all but the young John Reid (Klinton Spilsbury), a lawyer who had joined his Ranger brother, Dan (John Bennett Perry), in the pursuit of Cavendish. Reid, who was injured in the attack, slowly recovers with the help of his childhood friend, the Native American Tonto (Michael Horse). Afterward, Reid dons a mask, calls himself the Lone Ranger and begins fighting evil with Tonto. (movie) - 1981

circlecountry.us.title: Red Headed Stranger
circlecountry.us.description: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again. (movie) - 1986

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E07 Jason drives the Subaru Litchfield Type 25; Tiff drives the Ferrari 599 on the world's most treacherous roads.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E08 Tom Ford drives Volvo's stylish new coupe, the C30; Tiff Needell tests whether a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' biofuel powered Exige 265E.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson has a mini-moto race against some of the big names in bike racing; Tom Ford tests the new Land Rover Freelander on Britain's remote school run.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E11 Vicki is taught how to drive a car on two wheels; Jonny visits Germany for some extreme airbag testing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E13 The winners of the Fifth Gear Awards 2006; prizes for Best Small Car, Best Family Car, Best Fast Car and the overall Car of the Year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson risks life and limb in the most dangerous car stunt of all, driving a car under a moving lorry; Jonny Smith tests the new Mercedes C Class and its revolutionary seat design.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson makes an unprecedented attempt to hit 200mph in an A1 Grand Prix car; Tom Ford and Jonny Smith take the seven newest hot hatches on sale and decide which is best.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E05 Jonny Smith goes on a rather expensive road trip - in a £250,000 Rolls-Royce Phantom; Tom Ford is testing the new Porsche Cayenne Turbo.

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (movie) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (movie) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (movie) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (movie) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (movie) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (movie) - 2022

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script. (Mystery) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Rustlers
retroplex.us.description: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Boss

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

(Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-01-03

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. thestandupchannel.us.title: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son

thestandupchannel.us.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy

travel.us.title: The Aging Brain
travel.us.description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD. (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
travel.us.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen. (Paid Program, Health)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Death Sentence
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey investigate the site of Louisiana's first double execution; as they dive into the murky waters of the old Beauregard Parish jail's murderous past, the resident spirits begin to tell an unexpected tale. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Roff Family Rituals
travel.us.description: When the spirit of a possessed girl starts calling, Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey pick up the line; while communicating with the ghostly caller in Watseka, Ill., they find there's more to her death than anyone suspected. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Dead and Forgotten
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into a Michigan asylum to determine what truly haunts its abandoned grounds; as the guys sift through the facility's sordid past, they encounter restless souls who refuse to be forgotten in death. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Cross My Heart
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey do time in the most haunted penitentiary in the Wild West; they delve into ghost stories and uncover gruesome truths to confront paranormal presences lurking inside the Yuma Territorial Prison. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Ghost Town Throwdown
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey venture to Vulture Mine to dig into the haunting at the Old West's most notorious gold mine; the unexplained activity turns violent, injuring the crew and making the guys the target of a dangerous presence. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Go to the Light
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey dive into the Gulf Coast's Pensacola Lighthouse to shine a light on a horrific haunting; as the guys illuminate the site's past, they find the lighthouse itself may play an unexpected role. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Hotel Hell
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into Wisconsin's Karsten Hotel to uncover which spirits reside in the once luxurious lodgings; they discover that the terrifying ghostly whispers may reveal unexpected secrets about the hotel's past. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out - Flight or Fright
travel.us.description: Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey climb aboard the USS Lexington to confront a dark paranormal presence; as they dive into the World War II aircraft carrier's history, they reveal there is more to the haunting than anyone expected. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Binion's Hotel and Casino
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate two historic hotels inside an infamous Las Vegas casino with a dark and violent history; the long-abandoned hotels, sealed off and left frozen in time, have created a paranormal pressure cooker just waiting to explode. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - The Woodbury: Home of American Horror Story
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate the aggressive spirits who roam a 130-year-old estate in Altadena, Calif., that's been used as a location for various films and TV shows. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Panic in Amarillo
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew rush to a private home in Amarillo, Texas, where a family is reaching its breaking point with an aggressive entity; it's the guys' most complex and challenging investigation yet as they search for the truth. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Crescent Hotel
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate a historic hotel plagued by restless spirits in Eureka Springs, Ark.; they capture a curtain moving on its own and make contact with Michael, the hotel's most active and notorious ghost. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Mount Wilson Ranch
travel.us.description: In eastern Nevada, Zak and the crew investigate a mysterious ranch known for its concentration of supernatural energy and countless reports of extraterrestrial activity. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - A Haunting in Scottsdale
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate an Arizona home sitting on land once occupied by a Native American tribe; the owner claims he's been affected by a dark, aggressive energy and believes an ancient entity is haunting his property. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622

truehistory.us.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age - From Camels to Stars in the Middle East

truehistory.us.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age - Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon

waypointtv.us.description: The Journey Within

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Royals And Their Gardens - Audley End House And Gardens
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Audley End House, a Jacobean mansion built to impress King James I, became the centre of scandal when its owner, Thomas Howard, was jailed for embezzlement. Later a royal retreat under Charles II and a WWII spy base, the estate has seen royal drama, financial ruin, and espionage. Today, with gardens by Capability Brown and interiors by Robert Adam, it stands as a grand relic of England's aristocratic legacy. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Three Kings Of 1936 - Three Kings Of 1936, The
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Narrated by Tracy-Ann Oberman, The Three Kings of 1936 explores a pivotal year in royal history. Through rare archive material, expert analysis and eyewitness accounts, it traces the death of George V, the abdication of Edward VIII and the accession of George VI. Set against a backdrop of social change and political turmoil, it reveals how these events reshaped the monarchy. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Story Of Irish Dance - Steps Of Freedom: The Story Of Irish Dance
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Steps of Freedom reveals the extraordinary story how Irish dance evolved over centuries from a simple folk dance to become a global phenomenon adored by millions around the world. Featuring stunning original performances by some of the greatest dance practitioners and a wealth of archive materials. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Scotland's Scenic Railways - Edinburgh Waverley Station
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Scotland's heritage railways attract almost a quarter of a million visitors every year.
